_doc: Revert-verify mutants for requirement 02de55a4-0a07-4347-b434-bb4a48eb0163 (issue #4308, branch feat/property-replace-02de55a4) — the `property_replace` grounding primitive. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). Guards enumerated per integration-test-revert-verify §A8 from `git diff -U0` of GroundingExecutor.ts: the dispatch case (M1), the three argument guards (M2 targetProperty, M3 replaceFromExpression, M4 replaceToExpression), the list-shape refusal (M5), the absent-`from` refusal (M6), the idempotence branch (M7) and the index-preserving splice that is the whole point of the type (M8). Predictions were written BEFORE the run and are reproduced verbatim in each `_note`; every `expect` below is the MEASURED red set, not the predicted one (§A97 — a BROKEN mutant is the absence of a measurement, never a measurement). ⛤ Three guards carry a `success:false → success:true` mutation rather than deletion, and that is not a softer choice: each of them narrows a type for the code below it (`targetProperty` to `string`, the two expressions to `string`, `existingRaw` to an array), so deleting the early return makes the file stop COMPILING and the driver would report BROKEN — i.e. no measurement at all — instead of an axis verdict (§A36). The flipped form keeps the narrowing and still removes the only thing the axis observes: the refusal. ⛔ Two conceivable mutations carry no mutant here, both for a stated reason rather than equivalence: (a) dropping `quoteYamlString` around the written value — the axes parse the frontmatter back with js-yaml, so quoting is a serialisation detail they cannot and should not observe; (b) re-pointing the catalog UID of `exocmd__GroundingTypePropertyReplace` — that entry is locked by GroundingTypeParity.test.ts (bijection + 12-entry count) and grounding-type-vault-fixture-parity.test.ts (TS map ↔ exoas-exocmd submodule), both of which live outside this harness and run in CI. ⛤ R8 is the control for the untouched neighbouring `property_append` branch and stays GREEN under every mutant here except the dispatch one (§A37 — the stronger claim).

M1_dispatch_case_removed._note: The type exists in the enum and the executor method is written, but `execute()` never routes to it — the shape a half-landed migration takes. Predicted R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R9 (R8 green). ⛤ #4314: R10-R12 добавлены к ожиданию — снятие всей ветки диспетчера роняет и новые оси пустого выражения. Расширение внесла ЭТА правка, поэтому оно записано здесь, а не оставлено расходиться молча.

M2_target_property_guard_accepts._note: The guard still runs (its narrowing is what keeps the file compiling) but stops refusing. Predicted R9.

M5_list_shape_guard_accepts._note: A scalar target no longer earns the refusal that names `property_set`. Predicted R5.

M6_absent_from_no_longer_refuses._note: The load-bearing refusal: with the condition unreachable, a `from` that is absent from the list stops being an error. Predicted R3.

M7_idempotence_branch_never_taken._note: Always take the splice branch, so a `to` already present elsewhere gets written a second time. Predicted R4.

M8_whole_value_replace._note: Exactly the defect the type exists to prevent: the property is replaced as a WHOLE, so co-values are dropped. Predicted R1 only — R2 stays green BY CONSTRUCTION, because on a single-element list a whole-value replace and an element swap are the same write, which is what R2 is for. ⛤ #4314: R12 добавлена к ожиданию, и это УСИЛЕНИЕ мутанта, а не шум: новый контроль «обычная замена в списке с пустым элементом» замечает подмену всего значения там, где прежний набор её не видел.

M9_empty_resolution_guard_removed._note: #4314 secondary item. Снимает отказ на выражении, которое РАЗРЕШИЛОСЬ в пустую строку (guards выше ловят только ОТСУТСТВУЮЩЕЕ выражение). Краснеют R10 и R11 — обе половины, и это по построению: у пустого `from` и пустого `to` разные последствия (первый матчит чужой пустой элемент, второй пишет пустой), но один и тот же guard. R12 остаётся зелёной и это несущий контроль: она доказывает, что отказ ключуется на ПУСТОМ ВЫРАЖЕНИИ, а не на наличии пустого элемента в списке — иначе guard сломал бы обычную замену.
